name: Daily Standup
description: Evidence-backed status updates, decisions, actions, blockers, and separated deep dives.

sections.title: Yesterday
sections.instruction: Per-participant completed or recent work. Do not require the literal word yesterday; include evidence timestamps.

sections.title: Today
sections.instruction: Per-participant next work or commitments. Never invent an owner; include evidence timestamps.

sections.title: Blockers
sections.instruction: Risks and impediments with owner only when explicitly stated, plus evidence timestamps.

sections.title: Decisions and actions
sections.instruction: Decisions and action items with explicit owner/due date or unknown/not stated, plus evidence timestamps.

sections.title: Deep dives and parking lot
sections.instruction: Technical discussions that followed the status round. Keep them separate from participant updates.
